name: Cherry Gelato | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE 
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. 
Just like its ice-cream counterpart, Cherry Gelato is best enjoyed on a hot summer day or as an end-of day dessert. This cross of Black Cherry Funk and Acai strains will calm you down rather than amp you up. 
Cherry 
Lime 
Tangy
